description: Defines the AudioStreamLegacy class, including its interface, members, and related enums, for legacy audio stream handling in the Android AAudio framework.

classes.name: AudioStreamLegacy
classes.description: A class representing a legacy audio stream, providing methods for data callback processing, frame counting, and device interaction within the Android AAudio framework.

methods.name: callDataCallbackFrames
methods.description: Calls the data callback with a specified buffer and number of frames.

methods.name: onProcessFixedBlock
methods.description: Processes a fixed block of audio data.

methods.name: incrementClientFrameCounter
methods.description: Abstract method to increment the client frame counter.

methods.name: getFramesWritten
methods.description: Returns the number of frames written.

methods.name: getFramesRead
methods.description: Returns the number of frames read.

methods.name: checkForDisconnectRequest
methods.description: Checks if a disconnect has been requested.

methods.name: getFramesPerBurstFromDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the frames per burst from the device.

methods.name: getBufferCapacityFromDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer capacity in frames from the device.
